node: Semiconductor equipment, specialty materials, and qualification-gated tooling
summary: Expanded the universe around qualification-gated semiconductor equipment and materials for AI-driven leading-edge chip capacity. The reference lane is ASML because EUV/High-NA EUV remains the obvious lithography chokepoint. The underfollowed lane emphasizes US-listed suppliers one or two layers below major wafer-fab equipment OEMs: ultra-high-purity subsystems, gas/liquid delivery, precision power, plasma-process enablement, and contamination-sensitive components. These names have plausible AI-capex exposure through Applied Materials, Lam Research, ASML, foundries, and memory/HBM capex, but require later-layer verification of revenue mix, customer concentration, qualification status, and whether the AI signal is already priced.
